ranking.new_story_information: Adds a VAR-disallowed penalty (event_000622, replay-labelled) and a foul (event_000617) plus an interception (event_000635) as a pressure sequence between the deficit and the equalizer; the existing EDL only carries a single buildup shot (event_000472) in that window.
ranking.comparison_to_existing_story: The frozen plan and current EDL cover the deficit, one buildup shot, the equalizer action and scoreboard anchors. H1 introduces the disallowed-penalty beat, which is not present in the current cut, so it is nonredundant; however the causal claim linking the VAR decision to the equalizer is not supported by the supplied facts.
ranking.major_uncertainty: event_000622 is replay-labelled and cannot be promoted to source footage; the causal link from the disallowed penalty to the equalizer is an unverified model hypothesis; no possession or team identity is established by IDs alone.

ranking.new_story_information: Adds two substitution events (event_000563, event_000564) and a goalkeeper long pass (event_000598) as a tactical-change beat before the equalizer.
ranking.comparison_to_existing_story: The current EDL has no substitution or long-pass segment, so the events are technically new; but the claim that substitutions changed attacking organization is a state-transition hypothesis with no supporting event-level evidence, and the two substitution events are near-duplicates at 5557.6s and 5561.0s.
ranking.major_uncertainty: Substitution events do not establish tactical change or attacking improvement; event_000598 is a single long pass with no possession chain; no link to the equalizer is evidenced.

ranking.new_story_information: Adds three dribble-past events (event_000575, event_000580, event_000590) as an accumulating-momentum beat before the equalizer.
ranking.comparison_to_existing_story: The current EDL does not include these dribbles, so they are new; but the narrative association between consecutive dribbles and the equalizer is an unverified hypothesis, and the events are isolated with no possession continuity or shot outcome shown.
ranking.major_uncertainty: Dribble events do not establish sustained pressure or a path to the equalizer; no event-level link to event_000472 or the equalizer is provided.
